issue.title: bash_readline_inserts_what_bob_returned PTY test fails under parallel just check, passes alone

task_type_fields.evidence: Proposed by bob-cli-87.7 note #1 (bob-cli-87 land agent triage). On athena, 2026-10-16, during `just check` (parallel `cargo test --no-fail-fast`), `completion::bash::bash_readline_inserts_what_bob_returned` failed: the PTY driver exited after printing SETUP/EQUALS OK. An isolated rerun on the same tree passed (about 21s). Fail rate: 1 of 1 parallel runs observed by that agent; 0 of 1 serial reruns. The bob-cli-87 land agent's own `just check` at 5af6521 on 2026-10-17 passed this test, so the failure is intermittent. bob-cli-87 did not touch tests/cli/completion/bash.rs.

issue.creation_reason: bob-cli-87.7 note #1 saw this completion test fail under a parallel just check and pass when rerun alone; it is outside the note-snapshot epic, and no task tracked it.
